events.content: Verified all four issues still reproduce against origin/main at 95da12691 before writing any fix.

Fixed #3657 by putting the repo root on sys.path before the scripts.github_core import, then audited the five sibling validators with the same unguarded import and confirmed none is reachable by file path today.

Measured conflict-marker false-positive exposure on the real corpus first: 2 tracked files carry labelled markers, both inside fenced code blocks. Chose a fence-aware rule that never keys on a bare row of equals signs.
Probed the conflict-marker detector with 22 shapes (22 correct) and swept all 7404 tracked text files (0 false positives).
Fixed #3596 by moving both ADR-008 ceilings into pr_commit_count.py as the single source of truth and adding contains_base_merge so CI applies the relief the hook already honored.

Fixed #3610 with _unpushed_commit_count. Caught my own first design: plain --not --remotes=origin excludes the branch's own remote ref and would retire the ceiling on every re-push. Narrowed to --exclude=origin/<branch>.
Ran a behavioral probe in a throwaway repo: stacked first push measured 25 total and 10 unpushed; re-push measured 21 and 21. Both correct.

Wrote 47 regression tests, then ran a negative control against pre-fix source: 43 failures. Rewrote the first #3657 test, which was vacuous because pytest runs under uv, to invoke with -S so the editable-install .pth cannot mask the defect.
